title: uv install and verify
subtitle: A FIXTURE for the V-1 render spike. Not a published lesson.

FIXTURE.why: This plan exists only to prove the render path works end to end. It is NOT a lesson and must never be published. Its source_files is empty and every scene's source_refs names THIS FILE, because the gate checks source_refs for PRESENCE and not resolution -- a plan can point at nothing and still pass, so a fixture that pointed at a real-but-unrelated document would produce a green render whose provenance is a lie.
FIXTURE.not_grounded_in: No document. Every claim rendered from this plan was measured on 2026-09-28 and is either tagged in the source document or cited from docs.astral.sh with a page date.
must_not: have its source_refs resolved by a later pass that swaps in a real document without re-running the spike
FIXTURE.source_text: spikes/v1-install.source.md -- a fixture source, not a document. It exists so protected_trigrams can be DERIVED the way a real plan derives them from source text, rather than hand-listed. A plan with no source text gets no terminology protection, and the trigram gate then forbids the natural repetition of technical phrases across five scenes about one tool.

source_sections.heading: 3. Prove it is not on PATH yet

scenes.narration: Start with uv, dash, dash, version, then press enter. What comes back is a number and the platform it was built for.
bullets: Output is a version and a platform
Every later command depends on it
bullet_pages: Output is a version and a platform
Every later command depends on it

scenes.narration: Next, install it. The command is curl, dash, capital L, small s, capital S, small f, then the address of Astral's installer, piped into sh.

scenes.topic: Prove it is not on PATH yet
scenes.narration: Now try uv, dash, dash, version once more. It fails, and the message says uv cannot be found. Nothing went wrong.
The repair is a fresh shell. Run bash, dash, l, c, command, v, uv, and now a path comes back, ending in slash uv.
bullets: A new shell reads the edited profile
bullet_pages: A new shell reads the edited profile

scenes.narration: Finally, uv, dash, dash, version, now succeeds. Write that number down, because it is the thing you will quote when something breaks.

F1_RESOLVED.status: The V-1 spike shipped with a declared trigram exemption. F1 is now RULED and the exemption is REMOVED.
F1_RESOLVED.how: spoken_command_trigrams() in storyboard.py feeds this plan's protected_trigrams, so a command the storyboard declares on screen is protected terminology while the prose around it stays gated. See LLD 12.6.
F1_RESOLVED.gate: 0 blocking problems, verified against the real gate.
